game.q: flat on the road, blinded. what does the voice tell saul to do?
opts: get up, go into the city, and wait

wrong.route: close, honestly. but no route given. just: wait.
wrong.sorry: not yet. first he waits, in the dark.

game.right: YES. no plan, no explanation: go into the city, and you’ll be told. and when he stands up, he can’t see.

end.line: the man hunting jesus’s followers went blind, until a scared stranger called him brother.
end.l1: he hunted them. then he went blind.
end.l2: a scared stranger called him brother.

cliff.s1: next: brothers who sold their brother.
cliff.s2: years later they bow before him, and don’t know his face.

share: he hunted them down. then the light hit. the road to damascus on infinite hill
